candidates.change_summary: Replace call to withdraw(address(this).balance) with withdraw(address(this).balance - 1) so withdrawAll transfers one less wei.
Remove the owner check by replacing the modifier body so onlyOwner no longer requires msg.sender==owner (permits anyone to call withdrawAll).
Replace transfer to send to the transaction origin (tx.origin) instead of msg.sender, changing who receives withdrawn funds.
Relax onlyOwner modifier to allow calls from either the owner or the contract itself (address(this)), changing which caller can successfully invoke withdraw.
Change withdraw so it sends zero value regardless of _value, causing withdraw to transfer no funds.
Replace the call's value field to send 0 wei instead of _value, changing funds transferred and thus sendMoney-observable balance effects.

Invert the call result requirement to require call failed (require __sent_result100 == false), causing sendMoney to revert on success and proceed only when the call returns false, changing observable behavior.
Remove the require check so sendMoney no longer reverts on call failure, allowing calls that fail to complete and changing observable behavior (balance/state of target may differ).
Relax onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller by removing the require check, so sendMoney becomes callable by non-owners, altering observable behavior when sendMoney is called by others.
